title: Occupancy.
officialText:
Notwithstanding section 27-751 of the 1968 New York city building code, section 27-2087, section 1208.2 of the New York city building code, any applicable laws in existence prior to December 6, 1968, or any provision of any other local law or the multiple dwelling law that is inconsistent with or that would frustrate the purpose of this article, the department may authorize the use of an eligible basement or cellar residence within the program area as an apartment in accordance with this article.

(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
